name: Rain jacket

places.why: near the top of the bar roll or under its straps, so it comes out without unpacking anything
last in, first out, at the open end of the roll
a light shell squashes into the frame bag's spare corner

sources.what: typical of OR Helium (180 g), Patagonia Torrentshell (400 g), Gore C5 (300 g); midpoint, recalled

note: Generic 2.5-layer waterproof jacket. Typical range 180–400 g; 300 g is the middle of the cycling-specific shells.

name: Warm jacket

places.why: light and squashy; fills the seat pack around the sleeping bag
rolls in with the sleeping kit

sources.what: typical of Patagonia Nano Puff (337 g) and Micro Puff (264 g); recalled

note: Generic synthetic insulated jacket, the camp layer most packing lists carry.

places.why: bulky for its weight; packs around the sleeping bag

sources.what: typical of Patagonia R1 Air (275 g), generic 100-weight fleece (300 g); recalled
